id: # lane/divsnow: lane/chain2's s42k3 node 7490 End state proof, root-caused

cause: seed 42 easy, the overworld's snow country: s42k3 node 7490's chain (276,471 ticks). The server's entity digest differed at rows 267793 to 267795 and came back: squid 62757 at (-436.51, 53.08, -298.64), Pos[1] and FallDistance 0.014 apart. The squid, in falling water whose flow vector is straight down, took 1 damage in tick 267793 (Health 10 to 9). EntityLivingBase.damageEntity runs CombatTracker.func_94547_a, whose func_94545_a asks isOnLadder, then isInWater; EntitySquid.isInWater is World.handleMaterialAcceleration over its box, which adds the normalized flow times 0.014 to the motion. So a hurt squid's next move takes a third push (-0.0474 in y against -0.0334). C's living_damage_entity skipped the call. Fixed by asking squid_is_in_water there (not on a ladder, as func_94545_a); the whole Java recording equal at every row. Only the squid: every other kind's isInWater reads the inWater field; it needs a hurt squid in water with a nonzero flow (still water pushes nothing), which no stored recording had
